title: Semaphore 限流并统计峰值并发
expected_output:
信号量容量 = 2
峰值并发   = 2
完成数     = 8
限流生效(峰值<=容量): True
全部完成(未丢任务): True
code:
import threading
import time

# Semaphore(2) 限制「同时进入临界区」的线程数，
# 与 Lock 的区别：Lock 容量恒为 1，Semaphore 容量任意。

CAP = 2
WORKERS = 8
sem = threading.Semaphore(CAP)
guard = threading.Lock()
active = 0
peak = 0
finished = 0


def task():
    global active, peak, finished
    with sem:
        with guard:
            active += 1
            if active > peak:
                peak = active
        time.sleep(0.01)        # 模拟一段被限流保护的 IO
        with guard:
            active -= 1
            finished += 1


ts = [threading.Thread(target=task) for _ in range(WORKERS)]
for t in ts:
    t.start()
for t in ts:
    t.join()

print("信号量容量 =", CAP)
print("峰值并发   =", peak)
print("完成数     =", finished)
print("限流生效(峰值<=容量):", peak <= CAP)
print("全部完成(未丢任务):", finished == WORKERS)
